Body and physics: arena, quasi-steady wing model, FlyGym body, physical noise.
Connectome data layer: common schema, dataset adapters, homolog/crosswalk selection, sign rules.
Coupling of the neural engine and the body: causal command queue, recording, replay.
FAFB14 -> JRC2018F -> mirror -> BANC, elastix + thin-plate spline
Motor interfaces: readouts, the hand-made bridge and reflexes (control arms).
Neural engines behind one protocol (docs/05_ARCHITECTURE_PLAN.md section 3.1).
Sensory interfaces: FlyVis vision and its boundary layer, stimuli, gaze / odour / surface sensors.
Task ladder: open-loop stimuli, tasks and criteria.
lowest final validation loss at training seed 0 (prereg/14 section 6); a tie goes to the smaller rate.

online frozen FlyVis in the docs/08 closed loop
| A | rate BANC VNC subgraph | recorded FlyWire DN spike counts (spiking reference brain R) through the bridge | open-loop dA |
| B | rate FlyWire brain + rate VNC (VNC warm-started from A, same arm and training seed) | frozen FlyVis 1.2.0 -> boundary layer | open-loop dA |
| C | as B, warm-started from B | online frozen FlyVis in the docs/08 closed loop | behaviour cloning, then 5 DAgger rounds (beta = 0) |
| D | optional | - | needs its own pre-registration before any D run; never part of the section 8 verdict |
Plan 21: post-hoc analyses of stage A (speed generalisation and structure)
Pre-registration 14 — F5 training: optomotor yaw, curriculum A-C (D optional), connectome against controls
